name: pdf-miner
title: 矿工技能
description: Extract text and tables from PDF files with robust support for global market data formats (currencies, percentages, units). Use when: (1) User asks to read/extract content from a PDF file, (2) User needs text or tables from industry reports, research papers, or financial documents, (3) web_fetch or scrapling fail on a PDF. Supports: keyword search, metrics extraction, table of contents detection, PDF diff/comparison, LLM chunk splitting, batch processing, header/footer cleaning. NOT for: OCR on scanned image-based PDFs, editing/merging PDFs, or creating new PDFs.
